question: What causes regularity if the Lord shines ever-variegated?
premises: Endlessly declared before, there is no other cause in regularities, even worldly ones.
That very Great Lord, whose habit is ever-variegated shining-forth.
inference: The Lords variegated shining is the sole cause of all regularities.
plain_english: Endlessly declared before, they say: there is no other cause in regularities, even worldly ones — that very Great Lord, whose habit is ever-variegated shining-forth.
